introduction.p: Dayanara is a runner, and set out this morning on a jog with a goal to reach a nearby summit and return home in under one hour. She jogged a steady uphill path to the top of the nearby summit, and it took 36 min to get there. Now jogging home, she will run a distance of 2.3 mi. What will her rate (in minutes per mile) need to be in order to make the goal of returning home in under 60 minutes?

statement.p: Write an inequality to represent this situation, using x to represent Dayanaras jogging rate in minutes per mile.
Solve this inequality. Dayanaras jogging rate needs to beat what rate?
Use interval notation to express what Dayanaras jogging rate (in minutes per mile) might be.
